report.title: GPT-5.6 Luna and Terra: extended model comparison
report.introduction: GPT-5.6 Luna and GPT-5.6 Terra are the two newly evaluated models in this extension (160 scheduled trials). GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna and GPT-6.1 Sol were run earlier on October 4; GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-6 Astra are archived September 15 baselines. All seven models use the same frozen protocol.
report.model_research: On October 4, 2026, official OpenAI model pages and the full catalog identify GPT-5.6 Luna as the preceding Luna generation and GPT-5.6 Terra as the latest Terra. Both were released July 9. The account model list contained no newer Terra. Both document medium as default reasoning; no reasoning override is sent. Standard pricing was reduced July 30 and the new batches use the current rates.
report.cost_note: The GPT-5.6 Sol historical row retains the original M3 conservative rate table ($5 input / $30 output per million, without cached-input discount); it is not repriced to current rates. Other rows use their documented batch rate tables. Recorded LiteLLM costs are included separately.
